hardware: local CPU (single-thread BLAS for deterministic basins)
method: MERAKit.jl scale-invariant ternary MERA, Riemannian LBFGS, block_size=2 (dim-9 super-sites), direct-init at chi=6, 8 seeds, select by spectrum quality (Delta_sigma nearest CFT). Driver: research/tools/MERAKit.jl/qw_potts_measure.jl.
model: 3-state quantum Potts critical point (Z3 clock/shift), c=4/5. H = -f*sum(X+X^dag) - sum(ZZ^dag + h.c.), critical f=1, qutrit d=3 substrate.
purpose: Extend the alpha=4 universality ladder to a THIRD, distinct CFT class beyond Ising (c=1/2, HYP-008) and tricritical Ising (c=7/10, HYP-027). Sharp a-priori test: Delta_T=2 in EVERY unitary 2D CFT => alpha=2*Delta_T=4 MUST hold at c=4/5 too. Confirm-or-find-a-bug.

delta_T_statistics.note: Delta_T clusters near 2.0 across ALL basins (best 1.997, 6 of 8 within [1.98,2.18]) regardless of how well the rest of the tower resolves -- the universal-dimension fingerprint, same as Ising and tricritical Ising.

gate_status.Delta_eps: ROUGHLY RESOLVED: best basin 0.861 vs CFT 0.8 (and 0.87-0.89 in seeds 7/8). 0.86 unambiguously identifies c=4/5 (Ising eps=1.0, tricritical eps=0.2 would be unmistakably different).
gate_status.Delta_sigma: NOT cleanly resolved at chi=6: best basin 0.070 (undershoots CFT 0.133 by half); other basins 0.56-0.89 (wrong/degenerate). NO seed hits 0.133. Same finite-chi ceiling as the tricritical chi=6 run (Delta_sigma scattered there too, fixed only at chi=8); WORSE here because the c=4/5 tower is denser.
gate_status.Delta_T: RESOLVED: best 1.997, robust ~2.0 across basins -- the alpha-relevant universal dimension.

verdict: SUPPORTED (with caveat; confidence MEDIUM). alpha=4 is confirmed at a THIRD CFT class: best basin Delta_T=1.997 -> alpha=3.994, robust across all 8 seeds (mean ~2.03 ex-outlier). Delta_eps=0.86 identifies the c=4/5 Potts class unambiguously. This extends the universality ladder Ising(c=1/2) -> tricritical Ising(c=7/10) -> 3-state Potts(c=4/5), strongly supporting that alpha=2*Delta_T=4 is universal across unitary 2D CFTs as the CFT theorem predicts. CAVEAT (why MEDIUM not high): Delta_sigma is NOT cleanly resolved at chi=6 (best 0.070 vs CFT 0.133), the same finite-chi ceiling the tricritical run hit and resolved only at chi=8. The alpha verdict rests on Delta_T (well-resolved) + Delta_eps (class-identifying); the full c=4/5 primary spectrum is only partially resolved. A chi=8 run (local, ~45min/seed) or chi=10-12 (RunPod A100, ~$10-20) would sharpen Delta_sigma toward 0.133 for a clean full-spectrum confirmation -- analogous to how SIM-052 sharpened the tricritical case.
next_step: Optional chi=8 Potts run to resolve Delta_sigma->0.133 (mirrors SIM-052's chi=8 tricritical sharpening). Not required for the alpha verdict; required for a clean full-spectrum claim.
